name: mcp-atlassian-extended
description: Extended MCP tools for Jira and Confluence — attachments, agile boards, sprints, calendars

settings.name: JIRA_USERNAME
settings.description: Jira Cloud account email. With JIRA_API_TOKEN it takes precedence over JIRA_PAT.

settings.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
settings.description: Jira Cloud API token, used with JIRA_USERNAME (basic auth)

settings.name: JIRA_PAT
settings.description: Jira personal access token for Data Center. Ignored when JIRA_USERNAME and JIRA_API_TOKEN are both set.

settings.name: CONFLUENCE_URL
settings.description: Confluence instance URL (e.g., https://your-org.atlassian.net/wiki). Optional: only needed for the Confluence tools.

settings.name: CONFLUENCE_USERNAME
settings.description: Confluence Cloud account email. With CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN it takes precedence over CONFLUENCE_PAT.

settings.name: CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN
settings.description: Confluence Cloud API token, used with CONFLUENCE_USERNAME (basic auth)

settings.name: CONFLUENCE_PAT
settings.description: Confluence personal access token for Data Center. Confluence tools also require the Team Calendars add-on.
